feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 July 2026 3:21pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 26 July 2026 at 3:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred near the Azores. Low pressure over the Norwegian Sea, and a new shallow low developing to the south of Iceland later.


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 or 6, but only 4 or 5 in the west of the area, decreasing 4 or 5 in all waters overnight, backing southwest tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, then outbreaks of rain developing tomorrow especially across the north of the area.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in precipitation.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 occasionally 6 late in the period..


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in precipitation.
